name: Cascader
summary: Options in levels, opened one level at a time. Every level is a disclosure, so the browser does the opening and the closing and the state survives a reload.
summaryZh: 分层的选项,一次展开一层。每一层都是一个展开控件,所以开关由浏览器负责,展开的状态也能扛过一次刷新。

variants.name: Inline
variants.note: The level below opens under the option it hangs off, and a rule marks where the branch begins. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Flyout
variants.note: The level below opens beside the one it hangs off, as a floating column over the page.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The option text takes the caption size.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The option text takes the title size.

states.name: Open
states.note: The level is open. The browser announces it, and the arrow turns over in the inline run.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the option, because the option is what the reader is on.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The level cannot be opened, so the pointer is refused and the text takes the derived disabled colour.

parts.name: Panel
parts.note: One level of the cascader. It is a <details>, and it is the element that knows whether it is open.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: One option in a level. It is the <summary>, so it is focusable and the browser toggles it.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The mark that says the option has a level below it. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own.

parts.name: Children
parts.note: The level below an option. It holds the next set of options, each of which is a panel of its own.

props.name: open
props.description: Opens a level. It is the native open attribute on the details, so the browser keeps the state.
props.descriptionZh: 展开某一层。它是 details 上的原生 open 属性,所以状态由浏览器记着。

props.name: layout
props.description: Where the level below opens. The inline run is the base class on its own; the flyout run adds um-cascader--flyout.
props.descriptionZh: 下一层往哪里开。内联是只写基础类;浮层再加上 um-cascader--flyout。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the option text.

props.name: label
props.description: The text of one option. An option with no text needs an accessible name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 某一个选项的文字。没有文字的选项也得有自己的可访问名称。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the cascader inert. A level is a disclosure rather than a form control, so it cannot carry the disabled attribute: the whole tree refuses the pointer instead.
props.descriptionZh: 让级联选择器不可用。每一层是一个 disclosure 而不是表单控件,所以带不了 disabled 属性:整棵树改为拒绝指针。

slots.name: option
slots.description: One option: its text and the mark that says there is a level below it.
slots.descriptionZh: 一个选项:它的文字,以及那个表示下面还有一层的记号。

slots.name: children
slots.description: The level below, holding one option per branch.
slots.descriptionZh: 下面那一层,每个分支放一个选项。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when a level opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the details — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某一层展开或收起时触发。这是 details 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

a11y.notes: Every level is a real <details> and every option is a real <summary>, so the browser announces each option as a disclosure button and says whether its level is open. The keyboard is the browser's own: Tab reaches the options, Enter or Space opens the level below. The arrow is drawn from borders, so it carries no text — the level below is announced by the browser, not by the mark. A library with no JavaScript cannot work out the chosen path, so the path a reader has picked is the host's to write.
a11y.notesZh: 每一层都是真正的 <details>,每一个选项都是真正的 <summary>,所以浏览器会把每个选项播报成展开按钮,并说明它那一层是开着还是关着。键盘也是浏览器自己的:Tab 走到选项上,Enter 或空格展开下面那层。那个箭头是边框画出来的,所以它自己不带文字 —— 下面还有一层这件事是浏览器说的,不是那个记号说的。没有 JavaScript 的库算不出读者选中的那条路径,所以选中的路径由宿主来写。

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Three levels. Opening an option opens the level below it under the option, and a rule marks where the branch begins. Only the modifier class would change this.
examples.descriptionZh: 三层。展开一个选项,下面那一层就在它底下打开,一条线标出分支从哪里开始。只改修饰类的话就是这个样子。

Asia

examples.title: Flyout
examples.description: The same levels, with the level below opening beside the one it hangs off. The first level is open, so the second one is already showing.
examples.descriptionZh: 同样的层级,只是下面那层开在旁边而不是下面。第一层是开着的,所以第二层已经露出来了。
examples.markup:
Asia

notes: A level is a disclosure, not a menu: the browser owns the open state, so the branch stays open across a reload and the reader gets the "collapsed" and "expanded" announcement for free. The level below is hidden with `display: none` and shown again by `[open]`, because in the flyout run the panel is taken out of the flow and the browser's own hiding is not guaranteed to catch that. The mark that says there is a level below is drawn from two borders, so it takes the option's own colour.
notesZh: 一层是一个展开控件,不是一个菜单:开关状态归浏览器管,所以分支在刷新之后还是开着的,读者也能免费得到「已折叠」「已展开」的播报。下面那一层是用 `display: none` 藏起来的,再由 `[open]` 放出来,因为在浮层这一跑里面板是被拿出文档流的,浏览器自己的隐藏不保证能盖住它。那个表示下面还有一层的记号是用两条边框画出来的,所以它跟着选项自己的颜色走。
